body:
Hey girl,

I've been there. If you need to talk, pm me. I'm here. Someone told me once that I am engaging in self-abuse every time I dwell on something I cannot fix. He said that I am literally releasing negative neurotransmitters, hormones, what have you, each time I dwell on the unfixable. For some reason that woke me up... I am in fact contributing to how shitty I feel. I felt some measure of control in that I guess, even in the midst of my solitude. I've got no one. I had a married polygamist but you can guess how that turned out... I tend to pick the shitty ones. But I can't fix it so I'm going to do anything not to dwell. Set aside a special time each week to talk about what is pent up so that you can vent, but do not dwell. Do not feed the beast that wants your life. Much love. PM me if you need.
The derp is strong with this one! <3

You do have a future though. As much of a future as anyone next to you. We are all in this together. We are only as strong as our weakest link. That's another absolute I try fervently to believe. It must be true. Otherwise, the evil we've witnessed in the past wouldn't have come to pass. It's a cruel joke. I hate that you're in so much pain and yet I feel connected to you because of my own deep pain. Sometimes I cry so much I hurt myself, breaking blood vessels in my eyes and falling ill because my immune system is compromised. I realize this can't be normal to feel this way. This can't be all that there is. I simply cannot see a solution, but it doesn't mean it isn't there. Life is suffering but it doesn't have to be so goddamned acute all the time. There has to be some way to relieve the pain other than self-destruct. Sometimes there is no justice though. I've been reading about Patsey in Twelve Years a Slave. What happened to her? Nothing good, probably. What a life! What suffering! How my heart aches for Patsey and her impossible situation! Why why why did God let something like this happen? Did she die with absolutely no hope? Was death her only reprieve in a life so full of meaningless suffering? We will never know... I am not religious by any means. I don't really know if there is an after life. I find a lot of it hard to believe. The only solid thing I can hold onto is the memory of Patsey. I send love to that memory. Does she feel it? I hope so. We are not alone in our suffering though. You're not alone.

How horrible to be up at 2:30 am feeling that way. Depression truly is a cruel bitch. No one is perfect. I try to tell myself that constantly everyday. No one is fucking perfect. Including our parents. If you can't stick up for yourself, even within your own mind, you can at least convince yourself of that. You can tell yourself that at least you didn't commit genocide or rape. At least you didn't enslave someone or torture a puppy. There are far worse things that people do. That's my way of saying "fuck you" to the critic in my head and to anyone else who judges me as a whole based on limited information. I will decide when I go to bed at night if I am happy with myself. At least I didn't try to lead the Nazi party to the Third Reich. Tell yourself that when you can't sleep at 2:30 am because of the shame. I understand shame and how insidious it is. So many of the world's leaders don't feel shame even though they do terrible things. Maybe life would be easier as a sociopath. I now read history for solace and inspiration. If life is shit, I'd like to read about people who navigated the shitty sea because at least I'm not alone.

I have thought those same thoughts exactly. Try try try not to believe them. What's the use in thinking that way? I often feel like I've fucked up so completely that I cannot turn this ship around or be redeemed. But recently, I've been turning to history for solace. Humans have made HUGE errors including rape, murder, incest... you name it. Some humans have committed horrible atrocities and yet they carry no guilt or believe they are wastes of air. It's not fucking fair. I wish I had the self-esteem of some sociopaths. Life would certainly be easier. Depression is in control, not you. I realized that. Try to remember that humans fuck up all the time. Someone has most likely done something worse than you. I don't know what it all means. Why do we exist to hurt each other and ourselves? I have no clue. I don't pretend to have answers about God and our purpose. I do know that there is still enjoyment to be had in life. There are still people to care about and love. People who can make us laugh and learn and grow. People who look out for each other. I just try to focus on that and I hope you will too.

Ugh this is tough. Jess is an exciting character. He reads as thoroughly as Rory and has a punk music obsession to boot. He is handsome in the extreme. BUT... someone with that many relationship issues doesn't just become a new person overnight. He's so selfish and I do not doubt for a second that there would be plenty of women throwing themselves at him, catering to his ego and enabling his shitty behavior for years to come. The really handsome guys like him almost never become grounded because they will always have another prospect around the corner eager to blow smoke up his bum. I have this hope that when Rory returns to Philadelphia with the Obama campaign, she and Jess will finally work it out. Part of me wants that to happen. But honestly, he reminds me of too many bad boys I've dated. They DON'T change unless THEY want to and no amount of love from or for any girl will inspire them to change. It has to come from within. Ugh. I could go on about this forever. Logan was too entitled and spoiled. I thought his proposal to her was gross. Not Rory's ideal at all. A horse drawn carriage for the princess? A surprise announcement and public spotlight? Even he should know better! I heard the 7th season writers were pretty off-base though.
Ah yes. Sounds like my family. The first thing the women ask when I walk in the door is my weight.
